title: Is the Berlin Film Festival's leadership in trouble over anti-Israel speech?

contentText: PRESS REVIEW – Thursday, February 26: We look at reactions from the Indian and Israeli press after Narendra Modi's speech to the Israeli parliament. His visit is controversial back home. Also: the Berlin Film Festival's future leadership is in jeopardy after a film director's anti-Israel speech at last weekend's closing ceremony. Plus: superhero fatigue is here! A survey shows that teens want more sensitive portrayals of male heroes in the media.
